Jfs Wealth Advisors Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 8.14% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Jfs Wealth Advisors Llc sold 2,746 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 30,987 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $5.24 million, down from 33,733 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Jfs Wealth Advisors Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $950.11B market cap company. The stock increased 1.86% or $3.42 $187.25. About 20.20M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 7, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
